name: Two Cheese Spinach & Chicken Bake with Roasted Zucchini
ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Add to a medium bowl along with the oil and spices. Stir to combine and set aside.
Wash and dry the spinach (skip if it came pre-washed).
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add garlic and spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful; cook until the spinach is fully wilted, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Coat the bottom of a baking dish with oil. Place chicken fillets in the dish.

Spread ricotta over the top of each chicken fillet. Top each with spinach and mozzarella. Place the baking dish in the oven and cook until the cheese is melted and the chicken is cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and medium dice the zucchini; place in a medium bowl. Add the oil, Italian seasoning, and salt; stir to combine.
Spread the zucchini in a single layer on a baking sheet and place in the oven. Cook until zucchini is fork-tender, 12-15 minutes.
To serve, divide the chicken and zucchini between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
